basic_info.description: 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom, 1525 square foot full floor remodeled condominium. The elevator opens into the large living area with an east wall of panoramic Coit Tower, Bay & Downtown views. Pass the wet bar into the open dining area & custom kitchen. The bedrooms are on the west side of home with windows looking up Nob Hill. Coat closet then first bedroom. The middle bedroom is large across from linen closet, laundry & remodeled full bath. The large primary suite is at the end of the hall with excellent closets & en suite bath. Large storage closet. Leased parking available nearby. Urban Living! Monthly Dues are $1600.
